articles.title: Cancelled flight tickets: Airlines can claim GST refunds if fare and tax are returned
articles.summary: The GST Appellate Tribunal ruled that airlines are eligible for GST refunds on cancelled flight tickets. Singapore Airlines was allowed to reclaim Rs 45.92 lakh after proving refunds were issued directly to passengers.

articles.title: Industrial growth may ease to 6% in September as capital goods, mining lose steam
articles.summary: In September 2026, India's industrial production growth is anticipated to decline to 6%, down from 8% in August. Notably, capital goods production is projected to drop significantly to 2.2%, from an impressive 16.9% the previous month.

articles.title: Foreign investors withdraw Rs 48,056 crore in October as market selling continues
